headline: Southern (SO) Completes Moody Battery Project As Georgia Storage Buildout Expands
summary: Georgia Power, a Southern Company (NYSE:SO) subsidiary, has completed the Moody Battery Energy Storage System in Georgia. The facility is paired with solar resources and is described as one of the largest battery storage projects in the region. Southern is also progressing additional energy storage projects across Georgia to support clean energy deployment and grid reliability.
